card.name: Digit 2 inside parenthetical conversions
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (occasionally 8) right after an opening parenthesis, at the start of a converted or alternate number. It appears in dose, volume, distance and percentage figures like (2 mL), (235 000 tonnes) or (0.2 mmol/kg).

modes.label: Dose or volume in brackets
modes.description: A leading 2 begins the metric or alternate amount given in parentheses after a dose.
modes.example: A supplementary dose of 0.4 mL/kg (0.<<2>> mmol/kg) may be given up

modes.label: Distance or quantity conversion
modes.description: A leading 2 begins the converted measurement in parentheses after a distance or tonnage.

modes.label: Percentage of patients
modes.description: A 2 starts the percentage in parentheses after a patient count.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 2 starting a number inside brackets, such as an equivalent dose or distance.
